name: Reditus Company Expansion
author: DUO R&R
description: The Reditus Company Expansion offers a variety of new gear, weapons, and more for use in campaigns offered by the Reditus Technology Corporation (RTC) in addition to more general gear.

changes: Fixed Effect description for the Reaction in the 'Chronotardus Cybernetic Implant' gear.
Minor alteration to the description on the 'Explosive Crossbow' gear.
Corrected item descriptions for model numbering.
Changed 'Bust' to the proper 'Burst' in effect for Pathoparalysis Mine.
Corrected spelling of Thread to Threat for 'Threat Reduction' invade option for the 'Sensicrack' tier in the 'Autotechnocrat' talent.
Fixed values for some gear IDs.
Added Image in Manifest to display.
Fixed C4 size value, changed to 0.5 instead of null.
Added 'Clearance' tag to Mobility Hardsuit Mk.III
